name: Modern Living Room vs. Classic Living Room
instruction: Create a 3D model comparing a modern living room and a classic living room. The modern living room should have minimalist furniture, a large flat-screen TV, and sleek design elements. The classic living room should have traditional furniture, a fireplace, and ornate decorations. Position them side by side to highlight the differences.

Shape accuracy: The modern living room features minimalist furniture with clean lines.
The classic living room contains traditional furniture with ornate details.
The large flat-screen TV is accurately represented in the modern living room.
The fireplace is a prominent feature in the classic living room.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The furniture in the modern living room is proportionate to the space.
The traditional furniture in the classic living room is appropriately scaled.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The modern living room layout promotes open space and flow.
The classic living room layout is more enclosed and cozy.
The flat-screen TV is positioned for optimal viewing in the modern living room.
The fireplace is centrally located in the classic living room.
Object distance and contact: There is sufficient space between furniture pieces in the modern living room.
In the classic living room, furniture is arranged to encourage conversation.
The two living rooms are positioned side by side without overlap.

Instruction execution accuracy: Both living rooms are accurately represented according to the specified styles.
The side-by-side positioning effectively highlights the differences between modern and classic designs.
